title: PAR-134 DIMSTYLE DIMCLRD/E/T CMC correction and AC1021 alignment
mode: ODA/spec correction, existing-sample trace, generated fast slice
scope: Correct modern DIMSTYLE DIMCLRD/E/T parser and writer to the ODA CMC layout
Retain per-field DWG CMC method, RGB, names, book names, flags, and raw index
Avoid silent loss when exporting DIMSTYLE colors to the documented DXF profile
Use an existing repository AC1021 sample; add no persistent DWG/DXF fixture

odaSpec.version: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
odaSpec.finding: §20.4.68 marks DIMCLRD, DIMCLRE, and DIMCLRT CMC under Common; DIMLWD and DIMLWE are BS. §2.11 defines the CMC reserved BS, packed method/RGB BL, flags, and optional names. This contradicts the earlier local interpretation and governs the correction.

independentImplementation.version: 0.14 local dwgread build; source comparison to master
independentImplementation.trace: The local verbose trace decodes DIMCLRD/E/T as CMC index/packed method-RGB/flags fields and reads DIMLWD/E at the following field positions. The old libdxfrw cursor reached DIMLWD 18 bits later; the corrected cursor reaches DIMLWD at bit 988 and reads both signed lineweights plus the final flag.
independentImplementation.limit: This is independent parser corroboration for one checked-in sample, not native CAD acceptance or general semantic support. LibreDWG emitted its own integrity warnings on this sample; those warnings are not treated as proof of a libdxfrw defect.

dxfProjection.finding: The DIMSTYLE DXF reference lists groups 176–178 but no class-specific truecolor/name/book companion. Generic 420/430 entity color documentation is not applied to DIMSTYLE. RGB/name/book state is retained on import and causes a preflight refusal on DXF downgrade; scalar ACI/ByBlock/ByLayer remains projectable.

localSource.finding: The modern bounded reader and DWG writer now use CMC for all three dimension colors. DRW_Dimstyle retains the three CMC companion records, and copy/move/reset preserve their values. A DIMSTYLE DXF preflight refuses details without an established group mapping.
localSource.compatibility: No virtual interface changed. DRW_Dimstyle layout grew; downstream binaries must rebuild.

generatedControls.finding: Independent wire walking verifies named C3, RGB C2, default C1 and C0 fields, string stream order, following DIMADEC alignment, and DIMTFILLCLR adjacency. Production parsing retains CMC metadata. Copy/assignment and conservative DXF projection checks are covered.
generatedControls.limit: Generated writer/parser controls establish local codec consistency only; the existing AC1021 sample and independent LibreDWG trace provide the separate sample-layout corroboration.

productionSummary: Replaced the incorrect modern DIMCLRD/E/T BS reads with bounded CMC reads.
Replaced the incorrect BS writes with method-aware CMC writes and R2007+ detached-string support.
Retained CMC sidecars and refused undocumented rich-color DXF downgrade rather than silently dropping RGB/name/book state.
Renamed the generated selector from dimstyle_dimclr_bs to dimstyle_dimclr_cmc and updated the prior DIMTFILLCLR wire test to read neighboring CMC fields correctly.

unresolved: Audit remaining scalar-only CMC consumers against their class-specific ODA DWG layouts; do not extrapolate from DIMSTYLE.
DIMSTYLE DXF output remains intentionally limited to verified scalar ACI/ByBlock/ByLayer cases; no RGB/name/book mapping is established.
The AC1021 sample passes parser regression only. Its strict-complete DXF export remains separately gated by unresolved object dispositions.
J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL; FreeCAD native Linux/Windows qualification and independent ACIS/ACDS semantic evidence remain open.
